what.text: The central island: the ship sails itself in, three people on the way up from the dock say one line each, and the third points at the tunnel into the mountain.
what.source: docs/ops/BRIEF-YEAR-ONE.md beats 2 and 3, and docs/ops/ARC-MANIFEST.md for the names

when.text: Right after the beach, for about ninety seconds, and every time a student walks back out of the mountain.

how_to_join.text: You do not join it. Every run lands here.

content.blurb: the crossing, the dock, the tunnel
